summary.coreFinding: Heart owns CRM read/write/view/event parity for Leads, Kunden and Staff without importing apps/menyra-social/social-app.js directly. Heart still depends on shared CRM/leads helpers that currently live under apps/menyra-social/core/* and must stay.

removalOrder.title: Heart route readiness
removalOrder.action: Add Heart route-to-activeView mapping for CRM views.
removalOrder.whyFirst: Without this, rewriting /leads, /customers or /staff to Heart would show the Heart dashboard instead of the CRM target.

removalOrder.title: Route ownership
removalOrder.action: Move /leads and /customers rewrites to Heart; handle /staff only after route contract is clarified.
removalOrder.whyFirst: Social code should not be removed while direct routes still enter Social.

removalOrder.title: Social route acceptance
removalOrder.action: Remove/guard Social CRM activeTab route handling and auth restore for leads/customers/staff.
removalOrder.whyFirst: Prevents old Social CRM paths from being reopened through query/path/session state.

removalOrder.title: Social navigation
removalOrder.action: Remove Social drawer CRM entries or convert them to Heart links.
removalOrder.whyFirst: Keeps visible navigation consistent after route move.

removalOrder.title: Social UI/events
removalOrder.action: Remove Social CRM view renderers, event binders, modal overlay branches and auto-load observer wiring.
removalOrder.whyFirst: These are safe only after routes no longer render old Social CRM UI.

removalOrder.title: Social startup imports
removalOrder.action: Remove social-app.js CRM runtime creation, facade wrappers, write helper imports and lazy renderer URL/prefetch.
removalOrder.whyFirst: This is the startup diet target after all old Social consumers are gone.

removalOrder.title: State cleanup
removalOrder.action: Remove state.leads/state.customers/state.staff and dataLoaded CRM flags only after non-CRM coupling is gone.
removalOrder.whyFirst: resolveCurrencyCodeForMenuItem currently reads lead/customer state as a fallback.

removalOrder.title: Shared-core relocation
removalOrder.action: Optional later move of shared CRM core from apps/menyra-social/core/crm and core/leads into a neutral shared folder.
removalOrder.whyFirst: Not needed for readiness; useful later to make the ownership boundary clearer.

riskList.risk: Route rewrite before Heart path mapping
riskList.impact: Direct /leads, /customers or /staff could open Heart dashboard or wrong view.
riskList.mitigation: Add and manually verify Heart route-to-activeView mapping first.

riskList.impact: Moving /staff blindly could break staff subdomain/app flows or confuse CEO Staff with staff workspace.
riskList.mitigation: Clarify Staff route contract before changing /staff rewrites.

riskList.impact: Heart lead/customer/staff read and write operations break immediately.
riskList.mitigation: Only remove social-app.js imports/wiring; keep shared core files.

riskList.impact: Menu/product currency can fall back differently if state.leads/state.customers disappear too early.
riskList.mitigation: Refactor resolveCurrencyCodeForMenuItem before removing Social lead/customer state.

riskList.impact: Business-owner staff/account management can break although it is outside this task.
riskList.mitigation: Keep businessAccounts routes/runtime unless explicitly migrated.

riskList.impact: Profile/chat/post/menu/focus modals can regress if shared overlay code is removed wholesale.
riskList.mitigation: Remove only lead/customer branches after old Social CRM views are gone.

riskList.impact: CRM segments could accidentally become public business slugs if reserved protection is removed.
riskList.mitigation: Keep reserved route protection unless a central route contract says otherwise.

riskList.risk: Heart depends on shared helpers with social-app naming
riskList.impact: Future cleanup may mistakenly delete social-app-domain-config or social-app-cache-config.
riskList.mitigation: Treat these as shared config until a neutral relocation step.

manualTestChecklist.area: Heart direct routes after future migration
checks: Open /leads and confirm Heart loads directly into Leads, not dashboard and not Social.
Open /customers and confirm Heart loads directly into Kunden.
Open the agreed Staff CRM route and confirm Heart loads directly into Staff.
Load own/staff/archived scopes.
Create a lead with logo, Best-Spot logo, country, pricing and location.
Edit and save a lead.
Convert a lead to customer.
Delete a lead and verify linked public/social cleanup expectations manually.
Load own/staff scopes.
Open a customer editor.
Save customer fields and logo.
Move customer back to lead via status flow if this remains part of parity.
Load staff list.
Create staff with generated email, country, location and avatar.
Edit staff.
Delete non-self staff.
Confirm self-delete remains blocked.
Open /feed, /search, /map, /profile, /menu, /orders and confirm no CRM UI appears.
Confirm Social drawer no longer opens old CRM tabs or links correctly to Heart if links are retained.
Confirm public business profile /:slug and /:slug/menu still work.
Confirm QR menu link behavior remains unchanged.
Confirm businessAccounts remains available if not migrated.
